## Composition review

Voyager opens a Remotion or HyperFrames composition live in the Files pane so the user can play, scrub, and pin or draw notes on frames and elements.

- At every checkpoint, present the entry instead of rendering and end the turn: `voyager files present <piece>/motion/src/index.tsx --title "…" --deliverable none --json` (Remotion) or `<piece>/motion/index.html` (HyperFrames). Render the final video (`--deliverable <piece>`) only when approved or requested.
- Notes return with frame, pin or drawing, and target element. Edit the source, call `review_resolve` for each addressed note, and end the turn.
